scope.purpose: Review the completed consolidation and frozen-package routine results
scope.nonGoals: Acceptance execution, native linking, dependency changes, publication and commits
scope.preservedWorkingTree: Existing handoff, records index and follow-up audit changes were preserved.

changes: Document all three shared native symbol-layout rejections and distinguish selected style routes from SDK limitations.
Delete invokeWrapper and its helper-only tests; await wrapper results directly, preserving conditional-expression grouping.
Delete unused internal marker collision/gesture inputs while retaining raw selected wrapper facilities.
Replace the unused generic ornament registry with typed attribution state and update both native maps and fixtures.
Give useActiveCallback stable identity with useCallback, retaining committed callback replacement and teardown guards; remove native caller-side freezing.
Use the existing native camera owner for effective and observed state, with one scale request per effect and no duplicate movement subscription.
Replace per-family RNMapbox style assignment bodies with accepted-field lists and one spelling converter; retain explicit wrapper selection, omission and reset behavior.

publicApi.internalTypeChanges: Native presentation carries attributionPosition/setAttributionPosition; camera context carries effective and observed ViewState. No public entry exposes these internal contexts.

regressions.sharedNativeLayout: All three keys reject through common Layer on both native backends, six cases in source and compiled suites.
regressions.callbacks: Stable identity across replacement and StrictMode replay; latest committed callback, suspended-render isolation and teardown remain covered.
regressions.scale: One project/unproject pair per observed move, including unchanged controlled targets; controlled prop updates, readiness, metric/imperial/nautical units, stale success/rejection, current failure and unmount suppression pass.
regressions.attribution: Both native adapter fixtures check default/explicit control placement and restoration of selected placement and disabled state after removal; existing measured-overlay placement tests pass.
regressions.layers: Expression identity, zero values, ignored unknown/wrong-family fields and omitted/reset style values pass in the native adapter suite.
regressions.comparisonMethod: Temporary evaluation of the pre-change and replacement Layer components with mocked wrapper identities. Compared every original field with undefined, zero, false, null and an expression, wrong-family inputs and combined styles. Temporary tooling is not part of the package.

firstAttemptNotes: An early typecheck caught precedence loss when unwrapping await around conditional native feature-state calls. Parentheses were restored before routine source/native verification.

The temporary equivalence comparator initially could not resolve a transitive Babel plugin from the workspace root. It used the already-installed React Native preset dependency context; no dependency was added.

The first validate aggregate passed formatting, docs, types and source/native tests, then hit spawn EPERM in the synthetic owned-process cleanup fixture. The unchanged routine suite passed with process access. A read-only check found no matching synthetic test groups left running.
Initial frozen peer/example checks could not write Bun temporary files under the sandbox. The same frozen archive and commands passed with temporary-directory/cache access.
Final validate was repeated after internal TSDoc additions; its package hash matches the independently frozen archive.
diagnostics: Native fixture act warnings, Bun moduleSuffixes warnings and experimental TypeScript build-API warnings remain visible and unsuppressed.
